errors.text: The proposed degradation boundary of 350 ± 50 °C is substantially below the target threshold of approximately 900 K (627 °C).
The hypothesis substitutes macroscopic sliding tests for the target nanoindentation and friction simulations, so the loading mode, rates, dimensions, and thermal-control conditions do not match.
It assumes precipitate-controlled Orowan strengthening and dislocation climb without evidence that the target FeNiCrCoCu/Cu coating contains the proposed precipitates.
The cited bulk compression and creep studies do not directly validate the asserted wear-rate values, wear-mode transition, or coating-specific temperature boundary.
